title: Ehime CATV expands public-sector connectivity in Japan with Adtran XGS-PON technology
summary: Adtran today announced that Ehime CATV has selected its XGS-PON technology to support a new broadband network for public schools and local government offices in Ehime Prefecture, Japan.
body_markdown:
News summary:


- Ehime CATV needed a compact access platform to connect schools and municipal facilities without large shelf-based infrastructure
- Adtran’s XGS-PON technology enables the regional service provider to deliver 10Gbit/s connectivity through a scalable architecture
- The project creates a practical route beyond legacy EPON access networks while mitigating geopolitical supply chain risk


Adtran today announced that Ehime CATV has selected its XGS-PON technology to support a new broadband network for public schools and local government offices in Ehime Prefecture, Japan. The deployment will provide 10Gbit/s connectivity to more than 100 public-sector sites, supporting digital learning, cloud-based applications and everyday online services for students, teachers and municipal users. With its compact footprint and flexible expansion model, Adtran’s access technology will help Ehime CATV transition beyond legacy EPON infrastructure to ITU-based XGS-PON. The upgrade will also support a more diversified supplier strategy, helping mitigate geopolitical supply chain risk.
